title: Thermo-optic phase shifter: resistive heating, parabolic T, mode phase (analytic)
description:
A y-periodic glass strip (n0 = 1.5) is itself a uniform resistor driven by V0, so q = sigma V0^2 / Lx^2 everywhere; heat_em_thermo_optic turns the temperature rise into n = n0 + dndT theta for the 1.55 um plane-wave mode launched at x_src.
Analytic: with both ends held at T0, theta = q x (Lx - x) / (2 k) (peak 37.5 K at 2 V); mode phase wrap(-k_num(n0) (x - x_src) - k0 dndT / sqrt(1 - (n0 k0 dx / 2)^2) * integral of theta from x_src to x).
Derived values tab: dT_max, I_drive, P_joule (exact identities, ~1e-6), n_eff_mid = the discrete local index (2 / (k0 dx)) asin(n k0 dx / 2) at x_mid (~1e-6), and phi_up / phi_down = phase_positive of the mode monitors relative to the source against the phase formula (thermo-optic shift -0.70 rad at phi_down, ~1e-3 rad expected).
Sweep tab: phi_down, phi_up, n_eff_mid and dT_max versus V0 (0..2 V) with their references (V0 = 0 checks the cold phase alone).
Line profile tab: T_profile, eps_profile (em.eps_r = n^2) and V_profile. Field tab: heat.T and em.eps_r maps.
Field-transfer twin: disable coupling thermo_optic and enable thermo_optic_transfer (the same eps through field_transfer): every result must agree to float32 rounding.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: heater voltage in V (x_lo face at V0, x_hi face at 0 V; the sweep runs V0 = 0..2 V)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: k_vac
parameters.description: vacuum wavenumber k0 in 1/m

parameters.name: n0
parameters.description: glass index at T0 (eps_r = n0^2)

parameters.name: dndT_glass
parameters.description: thermo-optic coefficient in 1/K (exaggerated: ~100x silica, so the shift is large)

parameters.name: k_glass
parameters.description: thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: sigma_glass
parameters.description: DC conductivity in S/m (the whole strip is the heater; the optical sigma_e stays 0: lossless)

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: temperature of both strip ends and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (heat and voltage held on its x faces; CPML outside for EM)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: period along y (periodic EM boundaries, insulated heat / current faces)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size; the lines below sit at cell centres

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: mode source line (cell 50 centre), launching toward +x

parameters.name: x_up
parameters.description: upstream mode monitor (cell 80 centre)

parameters.name: x_mid
parameters.description: mid mode monitor (cell 200 centre, next to the hottest point)

parameters.name: x_down
parameters.description: downstream mode monitor (cell 325 centre)

parameters.name: q_heat
parameters.description: uniform Joule power density in W/m^3

parameters.name: theta_peak
parameters.description: analytic peak rise at Lx/2 in K

parameters.name: ksi0
parameters.description: half-cell phase n0 k0 dx / 2 of the discrete plane wave

parameters.name: k_num0
parameters.description: discrete FDFD wavenumber of the cold glass in 1/m

parameters.name: dk_dn
parameters.description: d k_num / d n in 1/m (k0 plus the 0.2 % grid-dispersion factor)

parameters.name: int_up
parameters.description: integral of theta from x_src to x_up in K m

parameters.name: int_down
parameters.description: integral of theta from x_src to x_down in K m

parameters.name: phi_up_raw
parameters.description: unwrapped analytic phase at the upstream monitor in rad

parameters.name: phi_down_raw
parameters.description: unwrapped analytic phase at the downstream monitor in rad

parameters.name: phi_up_ref
parameters.description: analytic phase_positive of 'up', wrapped into (-pi, pi]

parameters.name: phi_down_ref
parameters.description: analytic phase_positive of 'down', wrapped into (-pi, pi]

parameters.name: theta_mid
parameters.description: analytic rise at the mid monitor in K

parameters.name: n_eff_mid_ref
parameters.description: n_eff of the discrete plane-wave mode at x_mid (the port mode solve uses the grid dispersion)
